text.en:
The name of the Agbago Elementary School located in the Municipality of Ibajay, Province of
Aklan, is changed to Don Mauro S. Tumbocon Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: Macrh 7, 1984
